WITH bank AS (
SELECT :filter_month "Tháng",
ID 
FROM FMS_UAT.BANK_MONI
WHERE 1=1
AND TRUNC(LAST_DAY(NVL(DEC_DATE, DATE '1900-01-01'))) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) --Điều liện lọc
AND DELETED = 0
--GROUP BY :filter_month
),
repr AS (
SELECT :filter_month "Tháng",
CASE WHEN fb.BRANCH_FLAG = 0 THEN fb.ID END "VPDD NN",
CASE WHEN fb.BRANCH_FLAG = 0 AND LOWER(s.ITEM_NAME) = 'hoạt động' THEN fb.ID END "VPDD NN đang hoạt động",
CASE WHEN fb.BRANCH_FLAG = 0 AND LOWER(s.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%chờ đóng cửa%' THEN fb.ID END "VPDD NN chờ đóng cửa",
CASE WHEN fb.BRANCH_FLAG = 0 AND LOWER(s.ITEM_NAME) NOT LIKE '%chờ%' AND (LOWER(s.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%đóng cửa%' OR LOWER(s.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%chấm dứt%' OR LOWER(s.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%giải thể%') THEN fb.ID END "VPDD NN đóng cửa"
FROM FMS_UAT.FOR_BRCH fb 
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.STATUS s ON fb.STATUS_ID = s.ID AND s.DELETED = 0
WHERE 1=1
AND TRUNC(LAST_DAY(fb.START_DATE)) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))
AND fb.DELETED = 0
--GROUP BY :filter_month
),
fund AS (
SELECT :filter_month "Tháng",
ID ,
SEC_ID
FROM FMS_UAT.FUNDS 
WHERE 1=1
AND DELETED = 0 
AND TRUNC(LAST_DAY(ID_DATE)) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) --Điều liện lọc
--GROUP BY :filter_month
),
fund_com AS (
SELECT :filter_month "Tháng",
s.ID,
s.BANK_ID
FROM FMS_UAT.SECURITIES s 
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.STATUS s2 ON s.STATUS_ID = s2.ID AND s2.DELETED = 0 AND s2.ACTIVE = 1
WHERE 1=1
AND s.DELETED = 0
AND LOWER(s2.ITEM_NAME) = 'hoạt động'
AND TRUNC(LAST_DAY(s.REAL_ACTIVE_DATE)) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) --Điều liện lọc
AND (s.STOP_DATE IS NULL OR s.TO_DATE IS NULL)
--GROUP BY :filter_month
)
--=========================== báo cáo
, cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", s.ID "sraw", rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.VERSION 
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c,
posi.id,
name.v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL, 
                                                        '$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY, 
                                NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS 
                                                                        (r NUMBER PATH '$.row', 
                                                                        c NUMBER PATH '$.col', 
                                                                        id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hoạt động%' OR lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%danh mục đầu tư%')
AND s.ITEM_NAME IN ('HDTuVanDauTuCK_06016', 'Chung_TinhHinhQLDMDT_06020','HDQuanLyQuy_06014')
)
,cf AS (
SELECT 
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE
--, CASE WHEN cte.v IS NOT NULL AND cte.v != ' ' THEN TO_NCHAR(cte.v) ELSE rv."VALUES" END vl
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.MEB_ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON HEXTORAW(UPPER(REPLACE(cte.id,'-',''))) = rv.TGT_ID
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 2
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cte.row_idx, cte.col_idx
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY VERSION DESC) 
END ord 
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (SELECT row_idx AS rr, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS rsm, sheet_name AS s_r, report_name AS rn_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND ord = 1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3)
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, sheet_name, report_name
)
, hc AS (SELECT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, sheet_name AS s_c, report_name AS rn_c
                                , SEC_ID
                , period_type, period_value, year_value
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 THEN vl END) AS "Số lượng hợp đồng"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 12 THEN vl END) AS "Tổng"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND ord = 1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (4,12)
AND PERIOD_VALUE = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) AND YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) 
AND PERIOD_TYPE = 3
--AND LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)) = '60113e30450b46f3a63287269ed41006'
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, sheet_name, report_name, SEC_ID, period_type, period_value, year_value)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month "Tháng"
, hr_fn.sec_id
, hr_fn.rr, hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm
, hc.rn_c, hc.s_c
, hc.PERIOD_TYPE, hc.PERIOD_VALUE, hc.YEAR_VALUE
, hr_fn."STT", hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu", hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Số lượng hợp đồng", hc."Tổng"
FROM (SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.sec_id, dc.rn_c, dc.s_c FROM hr
                           LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, sec_id, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
         ) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm 
                         AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
--LEFT JOIN ord_rp ON ord_rp.row_idx = hr.rr
--                         AND ord_rp.row_idx = hc.cr  
--                         AND LOWER(RAWTOHEX(ord_rp.SUBMIT)) = hc.csm
--                         AND hc.s_c = ord_rp.sheet_name
--                         AND hr.s_r = ord_rp.sheet_name
--                         AND ord_rp.ord = 1
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY LOWER(RAWTOHEX(ord_rp.SUBMIT)),ord_rp.sheet_name , hc.cr
)
, dtck AS (
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month "Tháng",
rp.SEC_ID
, COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" = '170308' THEN CAST(rp."Số lượng hợp đồng" AS number) END),
        SUM(CASE WHEN rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('170302','170305') THEN CAST(rp."Số lượng hợp đồng" AS number) END),
        SUM(CASE WHEN rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('170303','170304','170306','170307') THEN CAST(rp."Số lượng hợp đồng" AS number) END)
) slhd
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND rp.s_r = 'HDTuVanDauTuCK_06016'
GROUP BY :filter_month
, rp.SEC_ID
--ORDER BY LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)), hc.cr
)
, dmdt AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
:filter_month "Tháng",
 rp.SEC_ID
, CAST(rp."Số lượng hợp đồng" AS number) slhd
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND rp.s_r = 'Chung_TinhHinhQLDMDT_06020'
AND rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180101'
--ORDER BY LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)), hc.cr
)
, aum AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
:filter_month "Tháng",
rp.SEC_ID
,CAST(rp."Tổng" AS number) aum
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND rp.s_r = 'HDQuanLyQuy_06014'
AND rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" = '170103'
--ORDER BY LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)), hc.cr
)
SELECT a."Tháng", 
a.value "CTQLQ đang hoạt động", 
d.value "Quỹ ĐTCK", 
c.value "HĐ ủy thác", 
g.value "Tổng tài sản", 
f.total "VPDD NN", 
f.hd "VPDD NN đang hoạt động", 
f.cdc "VPDD NN chờ đóng cửa", 
f.dc "VPDD NN đóng cửa", 
b.value "HĐ tư vấn đầu tư",
e.value "NHGS"
FROM (SELECT "Tháng", COUNT(DISTINCT ID) value FROM fund_com GROUP BY "Tháng") a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "Tháng", COUNT(DISTINCT ID) value FROM fund GROUP BY "Tháng") d ON a."Tháng" = d."Tháng"
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "Tháng", COUNT(DISTINCT ID) value FROM bank GROUP BY "Tháng") e ON a."Tháng" = e."Tháng"
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "Tháng", count(DISTINCT "VPDD NN") total, 
                                   count(DISTINCT "VPDD NN đang hoạt động") hd, count(DISTINCT "VPDD NN chờ đóng cửa") cdc,
                                  count(DISTINCT "VPDD NN đóng cửa") dc FROM repr GROUP BY "Tháng") f ON a."Tháng" = f."Tháng" 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "Tháng", SUM(dtck.slhd) value FROM dtck GROUP BY "Tháng") b ON a."Tháng" = b."Tháng"
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "Tháng", SUM(dmdt.slhd) value FROM dmdt GROUP BY "Tháng") c ON a."Tháng" = c."Tháng"
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "Tháng", SUM(aum.aum) value FROM aum GROUP BY "Tháng") g ON a."Tháng" = g."Tháng"

, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON HEXTORAW(UPPER(REPLACE(cte.id,'-',''))) = rv.TGT_ID
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 2
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cte.row_idx, cte.col_idx
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY VERSION DESC) 
END ord
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (SELECT row_idx AS rr, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND ord = 1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3)
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name
)
, hc AS (SELECT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, report_name AS rn_c, sheet_name AS s_c
                                , SEC_ID
                , period_type, period_value, year_value
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ trước"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 6 THEN vl END) AS "Ghi chú"
FROM ord_rp 
WHERE 1=1
AND ord = 1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (4,5)
AND PERIOD_TYPE = 3
AND PERIOD_VALUE = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) AND YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) 
--AND LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)) = '60113e30450b46f3a63287269ed41006'
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, SEC_ID, period_type, period_value, year_value, sheet_name)
, rp AS (
SELECT 
DISTINCT :filter_month mth
, hr_fn.sec_id
, hr_fn.rr, hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm
, hc.rn_c, hc.s_c
, hc.PERIOD_TYPE, hc.PERIOD_VALUE, hc.YEAR_VALUE
, hr_fn."STT", hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu", hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Kỳ báo cáo", hc."Kỳ trước"
FROM (SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.sec_id, dc.rn_c, dc.s_c FROM hr
                           LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, sec_id, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
         ) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm 
                         AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
--LEFT JOIN ord_rp ON ord_rp.row_idx = hr.rr
--                         AND ord_rp.row_idx = hc.cr  
--                         AND LOWER(RAWTOHEX(ord_rp.SUBMIT)) = hc.csm
--                         AND hc.rn_c = ord_rp.report_name
--                         AND hr.rn_r = ord_rp.report_name
--                         AND ord_rp.ord = 1
WHERE 1=1
--AND ord_rp.PERIOD_TYPE = 3
--AND ord_rp.PERIOD_VALUE = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) AND ord_rp.YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) 
--GROUP BY :filter_month,
--ord_rp.sec_id
--ORDER BY LOWER(RAWTOHEX(ord_rp.SUBMIT)), hc.cr
)
, dt AS (
SELECT a.*
,c."total%sl", c."total%gt"
, CASE
                   WHEN a."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('180102','180103') AND b."Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180101' 
                                AND (c."total%sl" <= 1) 
--                                AND CAST(REPLACE(a."Kỳ báo cáo",'%','') AS NUMBER) < 1
                   THEN (CAST(REPLACE(a."Kỳ báo cáo",'%','') AS number)/1)*CAST(b."Kỳ báo cáo" AS NUMBER)
                   WHEN a."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('180111','180112') AND b."Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180110' 
                                   AND (c."total%gt" <= 1)
--                                   AND CAST(REPLACE(a."Kỳ báo cáo",'%','') AS number) < 1
                   THEN (CAST(REPLACE(a."Kỳ báo cáo",'%','') AS number)/1)*CAST(b."Kỳ báo cáo" AS NUMBER)
                   WHEN a."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('180102','180103') AND b."Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180101' 
                                AND c."total%sl" > 1 AND c."total%sl" <= 100
                   THEN (CAST(REPLACE(a."Kỳ báo cáo",'%','') AS NUMBER)/100)*(CAST(b."Kỳ báo cáo" AS NUMBER))
                   WHEN a."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('180111','180112') AND b."Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180110' 
                                   AND c."total%gt" > 1 AND c."total%gt" <= 100
                   THEN (CAST(REPLACE(a."Kỳ báo cáo",'%','') AS number)/100)*(CAST(b."Kỳ báo cáo" AS NUMBER))
                   ELSE CAST(b."Kỳ báo cáo" AS NUMBER)
END pr
FROM rp a
LEFT JOIN (select 
rp.* 
, case when "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180101' then '180103 ; 180102'
           when "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180110' then '180112 ; 180111'
end child_mct
from rp
where rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" in (
                                '180101',
--                                '180103',
--                                '180102',
                                '180110'
--                                '180112',
--                                '180111'
                                )
) b ON a.csm = b.csm and b.child_mct like '%' || a."Mã chỉ tiêu" || '%'
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT 
rp.csm
, CASE WHEN GROUPING("Mã chỉ tiêu") = 1 AND GROUPING(csm) = 0 THEN 'total%' ELSE "Mã chỉ tiêu" END "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, round(sum(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('180102','180103') THEN CAST(REPLACE("Kỳ báo cáo",'%','') AS number) END),0) "total%sl"
, round(sum(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('180111','180112') THEN CAST(REPLACE("Kỳ báo cáo",'%','') AS number) END),0) "total%gt"
FROM rp          
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((csm,"Mã chỉ tiêu"),(csm))
ORDER BY rp.csm, rp."Mã chỉ tiêu"
) c ON a.csm = c.csm AND c."Mã chỉ tiêu" = 'total%'
WHERE 1=1
AND a.sec_id IN (SELECT id FROM fms_uat.SECURITIES WHERE deleted = 0 AND TRUNC(LAST_DAY(REAL_ACTIVE_DATE)) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')))
--GROUP BY a.submit_id, a.cr, a."STT", a."Chỉ tiêu", a."Mã chỉ tiêu", a."Kỳ báo cáo", a."Kỳ trước"
ORDER BY a.csm, a.rr
)
SELECT mth "Tháng",
round(sum(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180103' THEN pr END),0) "Số HĐ cá nhân",
sum(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180112' THEN pr END) "GTTT HĐ cá nhân",
round(sum(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180102' THEN pr END),0) "Số HĐ tổ chức",
sum(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180111' THEN pr END) "GTTT HĐ tổ chức",
sum(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180101' THEN "Kỳ báo cáo" END) "Tổng số HĐ",
sum(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '180110' THEN "Kỳ báo cáo" END) "Tổng GTTT"
FROM dt
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY mth

WITH cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", rt.ID rpid, rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME"
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS, rt.VERSION
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c,
posi.id,
name.v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL,
'$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY,
NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS
(r NUMBER PATH '$.row',
c NUMBER PATH '$.col',
id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (
lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%báo cáo tài chính%'
OR
lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%danh mục đầu tư%'
OR
lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hoạt động%'
OR
lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%tỷ lệ an toàn%'
)
AND s.ITEM_NAME IN ('BangCanDoiKeToan', 'BCKetQuaHoatDongKinhDoanh','Chung_TinhHinhQLDMDT_06020','HDQuanLyQuy_06014', 'CoCauToChuc_06018','BangTongHop_06013')
)

, CASE WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 6 THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 5 THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '1' THEN last_day(to_date('03/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '2' THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '3' THEN last_day(to_date('09/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '4' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
ELSE NULL
END MONTH_VALUE
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.MEB_ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, rm.RECORD_STATUS rs
, rm.RECORD_TYPE
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON HEXTORAW(UPPER(REPLACE(cte.id,'-',''))) = rv.TGT_ID
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 2
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cte.row_idx, cte.col_idx
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY VERSION DESC
                                , (CASE WHEN (lower(RPT_NAME) LIKE '%kiểm toán%' OR lower(RPT_NAME) LIKE '%soát xét%') AND id IS NOT NULL THEN 1
WHEN id IS NULL THEN 0
ELSE 2
END) ASC) 
END ord
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (
SELECT row_idx AS rr, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS rsm, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND SHEET_NAME IN ('Chung_TinhHinhQLDMDT_06020','HDQuanLyQuy_06014','BangTongHop_06013','CoCauToChuc_06018')
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name
UNION ALL
SELECT row_idx AS rr, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS rsm, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, NULL "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND SHEET_NAME IN ('BangCanDoiKeToan','BCKetQuaHoatDongKinhDoanh')
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name
)
, hc AS (
SELECT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, report_name AS rn_c, sheet_name AS s_c
, SEC_ID
, period_type, period_value, year_value, month_value
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 THEN vl END) AS "Giá trị"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 12 THEN vl END) AS "Tổng"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (4,12)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name, SEC_ID, period_type, period_value, year_value, month_value
)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT --:filter_month mth,
months_between(last_day(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'mm/yyyy')),hc.MONTH_VALUE) PERIOD_GAP
, hr_fn.sec_id
, hr_fn.rr, hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm
, hc.rn_c, hc.s_c
, hc.PERIOD_TYPE, hc.PERIOD_VALUE, hc.YEAR_VALUE, hc.MONTH_VALUE
, hr_fn."STT", hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu", hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Giá trị", hc."Tổng"
FROM (SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.sec_id, dc.rn_c, dc.s_c FROM hr
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, sec_id, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm
AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm, hr_fn.rr
)
, rank_period AS (
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month mth, rp.*
, DENSE_RANK() over(PARTITION BY sec_id ORDER BY rp.PERIOD_GAP ASC, rp.PERIOD_TYPE DESC) ord_period
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND rp.PERIOD_GAP >=0
AND lower(rp.rn_r) LIKE '%báo cáo tài chính%'
--ORDER BY rp.submit_id
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month mth, rp.*
, CASE WHEN rp.PERIOD_TYPE = 3
AND rp.PERIOD_VALUE = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))
AND rp.YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))
THEN 1 ELSE 2
END ord_period
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND lower(rp.rn_r) NOT LIKE '%báo cáo tài chính%'
--ORDER BY rp.submit_id
)
, rs AS (
SELECT DISTINCT r.SEC_ID, r.TOTAL_SCORE, r.RANK_TYPE, r.DATE_CREATED, r.DATE_MODIFIED,
rp.REPORT_YEAR, rp.PERIOD, rp.RATING_FINALIZED, rp.UPDATE_DATA_RATING
, CASE WHEN rp.PERIOD = 1 THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || to_char(rp.REPORT_YEAR),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rp.PERIOD = 0 THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(rp.REPORT_YEAR),'mm/yyyy'))
ELSE DATE '1900-01-31'
END MONTH_VALUE
, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SEC_ID, rp.REPORT_YEAR, rp.PERIOD ORDER BY rp.RATING_FINALIZED DESC, r.TOTAL_SCORE DESC, r.DATE_CREATED DESC) ord
FROM FMS_UAT."RANK" r
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RATING_PD rp ON r.RT_PD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RNK_GR_FTOR rgf ON rgf.RK_ID = r.ID AND rgf.CODE IN ('C','A','M','E','L')
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY r.SEC_ID 1c5f66443ada4fcc88ad6f4664cf0485
)
, pg AS (
SELECT rs.*, MONTHS_BETWEEN(LAST_DAY(to_date(:filter_month,'mm/yyyy')),rs.MONTH_VALUE) PERIOD_GAP_RK FROM rs
WHERE rs.ord = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month "Tháng",
s.ITEM_NAME || ' -- ' || s.SHORT_NAME "Tên CT",
s2.ITEM_NAME "Trạng thái",
CAST(d."Tổng" AS number) "Tổng AUM",
f.fund "Số lượng quỹ",
CAST(REPLACE(h."Giá trị",'%','') AS number) "CAR",
CAST(REPLACE(c."Giá trị",'%','') AS number) "Lợi nhuận",
CAST(d."Tổng" AS number)*100/(SELECT sum(CAST("Tổng" AS number)) FROM rank_period WHERE ord_period = 1 AND s_r = 'HDQuanLyQuy_06014'AND "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '170103') "Thị phần AUM",
a.RANK_TYPE "Xếp loại",
a.TOTAL_SCORE "CAMEL",
s.CAPITAL "Vốn điều lệ",
cast(REPLACE(b."Giá trị",'%','') AS number) "Vốn CSH",
cast(REPLACE(e."Giá trị",'%','') AS number) "Số HĐ ủy thác danh mục",
NULL "NDDPL",
cast(REPLACE(h."Giá trị",'%','') AS NUMBER) "Số NV có CCHN"
FROM fms_uat.SECURITIES s
LEFT JOIN fms_uat.STATUS s2 ON s.STATUS_ID = s2.ID AND s2.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.ID, count(DISTINCT f.ID) fund FROM fms_uat.SECURITIES s LEFT JOIN fms_uat.FUNDS f ON s.ID = f.SEC_ID AND f.DELETED = 0 WHERE s.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY s.ID) f ON s.ID = f.ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT pg.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pg.SEC_ID ORDER BY pg.PERIOD_GAP_RK ASC) ord_prk
FROM pg
WHERE 1=1
AND pg.PERIOD_GAP_RK >=0) a ON a.SEC_ID = s.ID AND a.ord_prk = 1
LEFT JOIN fms_uat.TL_PROFILES tp ON s.ID = tp.SEC_ID AND tp.DELETED = 0 AND tp.RECORD_STATUS = 1 AND tp.CONFIRM_STATUS = 1
LEFT JOIN fms_uat.JOB_TL_PRO jtp ON tp.ID = jtp.TLPRO_ID
LEFT JOIN fms_uat.JOBS j ON jtp.JOB_ID = j.ID AND j.RECORD_STATUS = 1 AND j.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM rank_period
WHERE 1=1
AND ord_period = 1
AND s_r = 'BangCanDoiKeToan'
AND "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '400'
ORDER BY s_r, sec_id, csm, rr) b ON s.ID = b.sec_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM rank_period
WHERE 1=1
AND ord_period = 1
AND s_r = 'BCKetQuaHoatDongKinhDoanh'
AND "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '60'
ORDER BY s_r, sec_id, csm, rr) c ON s.ID = c.sec_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM rank_period

ORDER BY s_r, sec_id, csm, rr) d ON s.ID = d.sec_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM rank_period
WHERE 1=1
AND ord_period = 1

--ORDER BY sheet_name, sec_id, submit_id, rr

LEFT JOIN (SELECT *

ORDER BY s_r, sec_id, csm, rr) h ON s.ID = h.sec_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT *

ORDER BY s_r, sec_id, csm, rr) g ON s.ID = g.sec_id

WITH cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", rt.ID rpid, rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME"
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS, rt.VERSION
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c
, REPLACE(posi.id,'-','') "uid"
, CASE WHEN name.v = ' ' THEN NULL ELSE name.v END v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL, 
                                                        '$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY, 
                                NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name 
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS 
                                                                        (r NUMBER PATH '$.row', 
                                                                        c NUMBER PATH '$.col', 
                                                                        id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE 1=1
AND rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (
        lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hoạt động%' 
)
AND s.ITEM_NAME IN ('BCTaiSan_06027','BCTaiSan_06116','BCTaiSan_06150','BCTaiSan_06134','BCTaiSan_06007')
)
,cf AS (
SELECT 
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.ROW_DYNAMIC
, rv.DYNAMIC_VALUE
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, rm.RECORD_STATUS AS STATUS_SUBMIT
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON cte."uid" = lower(rawtohex(rv.TGT_ID))
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 7
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
ORDER BY cte.r, cte.c
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY 
                                                 VERSION
                                                 DESC) 
END ord 
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS rr, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, report_name, sheet_name
)
, hc AS (
SELECT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, report_name AS rn_c, sheet_name AS s_c, 
                ROW_DYNAMIC, SEC_ID
                , fnd_id, period_type, period_value, year_value, STATUS_SUBMIT
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN vl END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN vl END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN vl END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ trước"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 6 THEN vl END) AS "%/cùng kỳ năm trước"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 7 THEN vl END) AS "Tỷ lệ %/Tổng GTTT"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
--AND col_idx IN (4,5,6,7)
AND ord = 1
AND PERIOD_TYPE = 3
AND PERIOD_VALUE = to_char(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))) AND YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) 
--AND LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)) = '60113e30450b46f3a63287269ed41006'
GROUP BY row_idx, ROW_DYNAMIC, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name, ROW_DYNAMIC, lower(rawtohex(SEC_ID))
                , sec_id, fnd_id, period_type, period_value, year_value, STATUS_SUBMIT
)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month mth
, hr_fn.rr
, hc.ROW_DYNAMIC
, hr_fn.csm
, hr_fn.sec_id
, hr_fn.fnd_id
, hr_fn.s_r
, hr_fn.rn_r
, hc.STATUS_SUBMIT
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."STT" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."STT") ELSE to_char(hc."STT") END "STT"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Chỉ tiêu") END "Chỉ tiêu"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Mã chỉ tiêu")  END "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Kỳ báo cáo"
, hc."Kỳ trước"
, hc."%/cùng kỳ năm trước"
FROM (
SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.sec_id, dc.fnd_id, dc.rn_c, dc.s_c
FROM hr
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, sec_id, fnd_id, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm 
                         AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.rr
)
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month "Tháng",
s.ITEM_NAME,
f.ITEM_NAME "Tên quỹ",
ft.ITEM_NAME "Loại quỹ",
--f.NAV "Giá trị NAV"
CAST(rp."Kỳ báo cáo" AS number) "Giá trị NAV"
FROM FMS_UAT.SECURITIES s 
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.FUNDS f ON s.ID = f.SEC_ID AND f.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.FUND_TYPE ft ON f.FTYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.DELETED = 0 AND ft.RECORD_STATUS = 1
LEFT JOIN rp ON s.ID = rp.sec_id AND f.id = rp.fnd_id AND rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2217')
WHERE 1=1
AND s.DELETED = 0
AND TRUNC(LAST_DAY(s.REAL_ACTIVE_DATE)) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))
--ORDER BY s.ITEM_NAME || ' -- ' || s.SHORT_NAME, f.ITEM_NAME

CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL, 
                                                        '$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY,

) name

                                                                        (r NUMBER PATH '$.row', 
                                                                        c NUMBER PATH '$.col', 
                                                                        id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE 1=1
AND rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (
        lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hoạt động%'

SELECT 
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE

, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1

, hr_fn.rr
, hc.ROW_DYNAMIC
, hr_fn.csm
, hr_fn.sec_id
, hr_fn.fnd_id
, hr_fn.s_r
, hr_fn.rn_r
, hc.STATUS_SUBMIT
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."STT" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."STT") ELSE to_char(hc."STT") END "STT"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Chỉ tiêu") END "Chỉ tiêu"

ORDER BY hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.rr
)

SELECT DISTINCT b."filter_label" "Tháng",
b."filter_value" mth,
CASE WHEN GROUPING_ID(ft.ITEM_NAME) = 1 THEN N'Total' ELSE ft.ITEM_NAME END "Loại",
SUM(CAST(rp."Kỳ báo cáo" AS number)) "Giá trị"
FROM  FMS_UAT.FUNDS f
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.FUND_TYPE ft ON f.FTYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.DELETED = 0 AND ft.RECORD_STATUS = 1
LEFT JOIN rp ON f.id = rp.fnd_id AND LAST_DAY(f.ID_DATE) = rp.month_value AND rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2217')
RIGHT JOIN label b ON LAST_DAY(f.ID_DATE) = b."filter_value" AND f.DELETED = 0
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS  ((b."filter_label", b."filter_value" , ft.ITEM_NAME), (b."filter_label", b."filter_value"))
UNION ALL
SELECT a."Tháng", a.mth,
N'NAV/GDP' "Loại",
a.total*100/NULLIF(gdp."GDP",0) "Giá trị"
FROM 
(
SELECT b."filter_label" "Tháng",
b."filter_value" mth,
SUM(CAST(rp."Kỳ báo cáo" AS number)) total
FROM FMS_UAT.FUNDS f
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.FUND_TYPE ft ON f.FTYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.DELETED = 0 AND ft.RECORD_STATUS = 1
LEFT JOIN rp ON f.id = rp.fnd_id AND LAST_DAY(f.ID_DATE) = rp.month_value AND rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2217')
RIGHT JOIN label b ON LAST_DAY(f.ID_DATE) = b."filter_value" AND f.DELETED = 0
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY b."filter_label", b."filter_value"
) a
LEFT JOIN gdp ON a.mth <= last_day(gdp.period_date) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.mth) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM gdp.period_date) AND gdp.ord_pd = 1
ORDER BY mth, "Loại"
) c

WITH cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", rt.ID rpid, rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME"
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS, rt.VERSION
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c
, REPLACE(posi.id,'-','') "uid"
, CASE WHEN name.v = ' ' THEN NULL ELSE name.v END v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL, 
                                                        '$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY, 
                                NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name 
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS 
                                                                        (r NUMBER PATH '$.row', 
                                                                        c NUMBER PATH '$.col', 
                                                                        id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE 1=1
AND rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (
        lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hoạt động%' 
)
AND s.ITEM_NAME IN ('BCDanhMucDauTu_06009','BCDanhMucDauTu_06029','BCDanhMucDauTu_06136','BCDanhMucDauTu_06152','BCDanhMucDauTu_06118')
)
,cf AS (
SELECT 
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.ROW_DYNAMIC
, rv.DYNAMIC_VALUE
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, rm.RECORD_STATUS AS STATUS_SUBMIT
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON cte."uid" = lower(rawtohex(rv.TGT_ID))
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 7
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
ORDER BY cte.r, cte.c
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY 
                                                 VERSION
                                                 DESC) 
END ord 
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS rr, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Loại tài sản"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, report_name, sheet_name
)
, hc AS (
SELECT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, report_name AS rn_c, sheet_name AS s_c, 
                ROW_DYNAMIC, SEC_ID
                , fnd_id, period_type, period_value, year_value, STATUS_SUBMIT
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN vl END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN vl END) AS "Loại tài sản"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN vl END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 THEN vl END) AS "Số lượng"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Giá thị trường"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 6 THEN vl END) AS "Tổng giá trị"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 7 THEN vl END) AS "Tỷ lệ %/Tổng giá trị tài sản của quỹ"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
--AND col_idx IN (4,5,6,7)
AND ord = 1
AND PERIOD_TYPE = 3
AND PERIOD_VALUE = to_char(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))) AND YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) 
GROUP BY row_idx, ROW_DYNAMIC, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name, ROW_DYNAMIC, lower(rawtohex(SEC_ID))
                , sec_id, fnd_id, period_type, period_value, year_value, STATUS_SUBMIT
)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
 hr_fn.rr
, hc.ROW_DYNAMIC
, hr_fn.csm
, hr_fn.sec_id
, hr_fn.fnd_id
, hr_fn.s_r
, hr_fn.rn_r
, hc.STATUS_SUBMIT
, hc.period_type, hc.period_value, hc.year_value
, CASE WHEN (hc.period_value IS NOT NULL OR hc.year_value IS NOT NULL) THEN last_day(to_date(to_char(hc.period_value) || '/' || to_char(hc.year_value), 'mm/yyyy')) END month_value
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."STT" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."STT") ELSE to_char(hc."STT") END "STT"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Loại tài sản" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Loại tài sản") ELSE to_char(hc."Loại tài sản") END "Loại tài sản"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Mã chỉ tiêu")  END "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Số lượng"
, hc."Giá thị trường"
, hc."Tổng giá trị"
, hc."Tỷ lệ %/Tổng giá trị tài sản của quỹ"
FROM (
SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.sec_id, dc.fnd_id, dc.rn_c, dc.s_c
FROM hr
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, sec_id, fnd_id, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm 
                         AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.rr
)
SELECT mth "Tháng",
"Loại tài sản",
SUM(value) "Giá trị tài sản",
SUM(value)*100/SUM(SUM(value)) OVER (PARTITION BY mth) "Tỷ lệ"
FROM (
SELECT :filter_month mth, sec_id, fnd_id
, 'Cổ phiếu niêm yết' "Loại tài sản"
, COALESCE(max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2247' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END),max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2246' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END)) value
FROM rp
WHERE "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2246','2247')
GROUP BY :filter_month, sec_id, fnd_id, 'Cổ phiếu niêm yết'
UNION 
SELECT :filter_month mth, sec_id, fnd_id
, 'Cổ phiếu chưa niêm yết' "Loại tài sản"
, COALESCE(max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2249' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END),max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2248' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END)) value
FROM rp
WHERE "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2248','2249')
GROUP BY :filter_month, sec_id, fnd_id, 'Cổ phiếu chưa niêm yết'
UNION
SELECT :filter_month mth, sec_id, fnd_id
, 'Trái phiếu' "Loại tài sản"
, COALESCE(max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2252' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END),max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2251' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END)) value
FROM rp
WHERE "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2251','2252')
GROUP BY :filter_month, sec_id, fnd_id, 'Trái phiếu'
UNION
SELECT :filter_month mth, sec_id, fnd_id
, 'Tiền' "Loại tài sản"
, COALESCE(max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2262' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END),max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2258' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END)) value
FROM rp
WHERE "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2258','2262')
GROUP BY :filter_month, sec_id, fnd_id, 'Tiền'
UNION
SELECT :filter_month mth, sec_id, fnd_id
, 'Các loại chứng khoán khác' "Loại tài sản"
, COALESCE(max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2254' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END),max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2253' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END)) value
FROM rp
WHERE "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2253','2254')
GROUP BY :filter_month, sec_id, fnd_id, 'Các loại chứng khoán khác'
UNION
SELECT :filter_month mth, sec_id, fnd_id
, 'Các tài sản khác' "Loại tài sản"
, COALESCE(max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2257' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END),max(CASE WHEN "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2256' THEN "Tổng giá trị" END)) value
FROM rp
WHERE "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2256','2257')
GROUP BY :filter_month, sec_id, fnd_id, 'Các tài sản khác'
) a
WHERE 1=1
AND fnd_id IN (SELECT id FROM FMS_UAT.FUNDS WHERE DELETED = 0 AND TRUNC(LAST_DAY(ID_DATE)) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')))
GROUP BY mth, "Loại tài sản"
ORDER BY "Loại tài sản"

column20:
WITH cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", rt.ID rpid, rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME"
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS, rt.VERSION
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c
, REPLACE(posi.id,'-','') "uid"
, CASE WHEN name.v = ' ' THEN NULL ELSE name.v END v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL, 
                                                        '$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY, 
                                NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name 
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS 
                                                                        (r NUMBER PATH '$.row', 
                                                                        c NUMBER PATH '$.col', 
                                                                        id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE 1=1
AND rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (
        lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hoạt động%' 
)
AND s.ITEM_NAME IN ('BCTaiSan_06027','BCTaiSan_06116','BCTaiSan_06150','BCTaiSan_06134','BCTaiSan_06007')
)
,cf AS (
SELECT 
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.ROW_DYNAMIC
, rv.DYNAMIC_VALUE
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, rm.RECORD_STATUS AS STATUS_SUBMIT
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON cte."uid" = lower(rawtohex(rv.TGT_ID))
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 7
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
ORDER BY cte.r, cte.c
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY 
                                                 VERSION
                                                 DESC) 
END ord 
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS rr, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, report_name, sheet_name
)
, hc AS (
SELECT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, report_name AS rn_c, sheet_name AS s_c, 
                ROW_DYNAMIC, SEC_ID
                , fnd_id, period_type, period_value, year_value, STATUS_SUBMIT
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN vl END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN vl END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN vl END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ trước"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 6 THEN vl END) AS "%/cùng kỳ năm trước"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 7 THEN vl END) AS "Tỷ lệ %/Tổng GTTT"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
--AND col_idx IN (4,5,6,7)
AND ord = 1
AND PERIOD_TYPE = 3
--AND PERIOD_VALUE = to_char(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))) AND YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) 
--AND LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)) = '60113e30450b46f3a63287269ed41006'
GROUP BY row_idx, ROW_DYNAMIC, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name, ROW_DYNAMIC, lower(rawtohex(SEC_ID))
                , sec_id, fnd_id, period_type, period_value, year_value, STATUS_SUBMIT
)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
 hr_fn.rr
, hc.ROW_DYNAMIC
, hr_fn.csm
, hr_fn.sec_id
, hr_fn.fnd_id
, hr_fn.s_r
, hr_fn.rn_r
, hc.STATUS_SUBMIT
, hc.period_type, hc.period_value, hc.year_value
, CASE WHEN (hc.period_value IS NOT NULL OR hc.year_value IS NOT NULL) THEN last_day(to_date(to_char(hc.period_value) || '/' || to_char(hc.year_value), 'mm/yyyy')) END month_value
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."STT" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."STT") ELSE to_char(hc."STT") END "STT"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Chỉ tiêu") END "Chỉ tiêu"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Mã chỉ tiêu")  END "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Kỳ báo cáo"
, hc."Kỳ trước"
, hc."%/cùng kỳ năm trước"
FROM (
SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.sec_id, dc.fnd_id, dc.rn_c, dc.s_c
FROM hr
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, sec_id, fnd_id, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm 
                         AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.rr
)
, label AS (
SELECT ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_fr,'MM/YYYY')), LEVEL - 2) "filter_value",
TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(:filter_fr,'MM/YYYY'),LEVEL - 2),'MM/YYYY') "filter_label"
FROM dual
CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 
MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(:filter_to,'MM/YYYY'),TO_DATE(:filter_fr,'MM/YYYY')) + 2
ORDER BY ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(:filter_fr,'MM/YYYY'), LEVEL - 2)
)
, dt AS (
SELECT  b."filter_label" "Tháng"
, min(b."filter_value") mth
, SUM(CAST(rp."Kỳ báo cáo" AS number)) "Giá trị NAV"
FROM FMS_UAT.FUNDS f
LEFT JOIN rp ON f.id = rp.fnd_id AND LAST_DAY(f.ID_DATE) = rp.month_value AND rp."Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('2217')
RIGHT JOIN label b ON LAST_DAY(f.ID_DATE) = b."filter_value" AND f.DELETED = 0
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY b."filter_label"
ORDER BY min(b."filter_value")
)
SELECT "Tháng", "Giá trị NAV", "% Tăng trưởng"
, AVG("% Tăng trưởng") OVER () "TB % tăng trưởng"
FROM (
SELECT 
a."Tháng", a."Giá trị NAV", a.mth
, (NULLIF(a."Giá trị NAV",0) - NULLIF(b."Giá trị NAV",0))*100/NULLIF(b."Giá trị NAV",0) "% Tăng trưởng"
FROM dt a
LEFT JOIN dt b ON a.mth = add_months(b.mth,1)
) fn
WHERE mth >= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_fr,'MM/YYYY'))

WITH label AS (
SELECT ADD_MONTHS(last_day(cvt.convert_fr), LEVEL - 1) "filter_value",
CASE WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'tháng' THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr,LEVEL - 1),'MM/YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr,LEVEL - 1)) IN (1,2,3) THEN 'Quý 1/' || TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr, LEVEL - 1),'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr,LEVEL - 1)) IN (4,5,6) THEN 'Quý 2/' || TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr, LEVEL - 1),'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr,LEVEL - 1)) IN (7,8,9) THEN 'Quý 3/' || TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr, LEVEL - 1),'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr,LEVEL - 1)) IN (10,11,12) THEN 'Quý 4/' || TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr,LEVEL - 1),'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'năm' THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr, LEVEL - 1),'YYYY')
 END "filter_label"
FROM (
SELECT  
CASE WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter_fr,1,2)) = 'q1' THEN to_date('01/' || SUBSTR(:filter_fr,-4),'mm/yyyy')
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter_fr,1,2)) = 'q2' THEN to_date('04/' || SUBSTR(:filter_fr,-4),'mm/yyyy')
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter_fr,1,2)) = 'q3' THEN to_date('07/' || SUBSTR(:filter_fr,-4),'mm/yyyy')
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter_fr,1,2)) = 'q4' THEN to_date('10/' || SUBSTR(:filter_fr,-4),'mm/yyyy')
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'năm' THEN to_date('01/' || to_char(:filter_fr),'mm/yyyy')
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'tháng' THEN to_date(:filter_fr,'mm/yyyy')
END convert_fr
, CASE WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter_to,1,2)) = 'q1' THEN last_day(to_date('03/' || SUBSTR(:filter_to,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter_to,1,2)) = 'q2' THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || SUBSTR(:filter_to,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter_to,1,2)) = 'q3' THEN last_day(to_date('09/' || SUBSTR(:filter_to,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter_to,1,2)) = 'q4' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || SUBSTR(:filter_to,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'năm' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(:filter_to),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'tháng' THEN last_day(to_date(:filter_to,'mm/yyyy'))
END convert_to
FROM dual
) cvt
CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 
MONTHS_BETWEEN(cvt.convert_to,cvt.convert_fr) + 1
ORDER BY ADD_MONTHS(cvt.convert_fr, LEVEL - 1)
)

WITH cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", rt.ID rpid, rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME"
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS, rt.VERSION
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c
, REPLACE(posi.id,'-','') "uid"
, CASE WHEN name.v = ' ' THEN NULL ELSE name.v END v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL, 
                                                        '$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY, 
                                NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name 
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS 
                                                                        (r NUMBER PATH '$.row', 
                                                                        c NUMBER PATH '$.col', 
                                                                        id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE 1=1
AND rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (
        lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hoạt động%' 
)
AND s.ITEM_NAME IN ('BCTaiSan_06027','BCTaiSan_06116','BCTaiSan_06150','BCTaiSan_06134','BCTaiSan_06007')
)
,cf AS (
SELECT 
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.ROW_DYNAMIC
, rv.DYNAMIC_VALUE
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, rm.RECORD_STATUS AS STATUS_SUBMIT
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON cte."uid" = lower(rawtohex(rv.TGT_ID))
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 7
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
ORDER BY cte.r, cte.c
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY 
                                                 VERSION
                                                 DESC) 
END ord 
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS rr, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, report_name, sheet_name
)
, hc AS (
SELECT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, report_name AS rn_c, sheet_name AS s_c, 
                ROW_DYNAMIC, SEC_ID
                , fnd_id, period_type, period_value, year_value, STATUS_SUBMIT
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN vl END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN vl END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN vl END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ trước"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 6 THEN vl END) AS "%/cùng kỳ năm trước"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 7 THEN vl END) AS "Tỷ lệ %/Tổng GTTT"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
--AND col_idx IN (4,5,6,7)
AND ord = 1
AND PERIOD_TYPE = 3
--AND PERIOD_VALUE = to_char(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))) AND YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) 
--AND LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)) = '60113e30450b46f3a63287269ed41006'
GROUP BY row_idx, ROW_DYNAMIC, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name, ROW_DYNAMIC, lower(rawtohex(SEC_ID))
                , sec_id, fnd_id, period_type, period_value, year_value, STATUS_SUBMIT
)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
 hr_fn.rr
, hc.ROW_DYNAMIC
, hr_fn.csm
, hr_fn.sec_id
, hr_fn.fnd_id
, hr_fn.s_r
, hr_fn.rn_r
, hc.STATUS_SUBMIT
, hc.period_type, hc.period_value, hc.year_value
, CASE WHEN (hc.period_value IS NOT NULL OR hc.year_value IS NOT NULL) THEN last_day(to_date(to_char(hc.period_value) || '/' || to_char(hc.year_value), 'mm/yyyy')) END month_value
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."STT" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."STT") ELSE to_char(hc."STT") END "STT"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Chỉ tiêu") END "Chỉ tiêu"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Mã chỉ tiêu")  END "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Kỳ báo cáo"
, hc."Kỳ trước"
, hc."%/cùng kỳ năm trước"
FROM (
SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.sec_id, dc.fnd_id, dc.rn_c, dc.s_c
FROM hr
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, sec_id, fnd_id, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm 
                         AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.rr
)

WITH cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", rt.ID rpid, rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME"
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS, rt.VERSION
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c,
posi.id,
name.v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL,
'$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY,
NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS
(r NUMBER PATH '$.row',
c NUMBER PATH '$.col',
id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (
lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%báo cáo tài chính%'
OR
lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%hoạt động%'
)
AND (
s.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%BCTaiSan%'
OR
s.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%BCKetQuaHoạtDongKinhDoanh%'
OR 
s.ITEM_NAME = 'BCThuNhap_06203'
)
)
,cf AS (
SELECT
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE
, CASE WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 6 THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 5 THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '1' THEN last_day(to_date('03/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '2' THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '3' THEN last_day(to_date('09/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '4' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
ELSE NULL
END MONTH_VALUE
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.MEB_ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, rm.RECORD_STATUS rs
, rm.RECORD_TYPE
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON HEXTORAW(UPPER(REPLACE(cte.id,'-',''))) = rv.TGT_ID
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 7
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY cte.row_idx, cte.col_idx
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY VERSION DESC
                                , (CASE WHEN (lower(RPT_NAME) LIKE '%kiểm toán%' OR lower(RPT_NAME) LIKE '%soát xét%') AND id IS NOT NULL THEN 1
WHEN id IS NULL THEN 0
ELSE 2
END) ASC) 
END ord
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS rr, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND SHEET_NAME LIKE '%BCTaiSan%'
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS rr, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, NULL "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND (SHEET_NAME LIKE '%BCKetQuaHoạtDongKinhDoanh%' OR SHEET_NAME = 'BCThuNhap_06203')
AND row_idx NOT IN (1,2)
AND col_idx IN (1,2)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name
)
, hc AS (
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, report_name AS rn_c, sheet_name AS s_c
, SEC_ID, FND_ID
, period_type, period_value, year_value, month_value
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 AND SHEET_NAME LIKE '%BCTaiSan%' THEN vl END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 AND SHEET_NAME LIKE '%BCTaiSan%' THEN vl END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 AND SHEET_NAME LIKE '%BCTaiSan%' THEN vl END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 AND (SHEET_NAME LIKE '%BCTaiSan%' OR SHEET_NAME LIKE '%BCKetQuaHoạtDongKinhDoanh%') THEN vl 
                   WHEN col_idx = 5 AND SHEET_NAME = 'BCThuNhap_06203' THEN vl
END) AS "Giá trị"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ trước"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2,3,4,5)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name, SEC_ID, FND_ID, period_type, period_value, year_value, month_value
)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
months_between(last_day(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'mm/yyyy')),hc.MONTH_VALUE) PERIOD_GAP
, hr_fn.sec_id, hr_fn.fnd_id
, hr_fn.rr, hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm
, hc.rn_c, hc.s_c
, hc.PERIOD_TYPE, hc.PERIOD_VALUE, hc.YEAR_VALUE, hc.MONTH_VALUE
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."STT" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."STT") ELSE to_char(hc."STT") END "STT"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Chỉ tiêu") END "Chỉ tiêu"
, CASE WHEN hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu" IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(hr_fn."Mã chỉ tiêu") ELSE to_char(hc."Mã chỉ tiêu")  END "Mã chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Giá trị"
FROM (SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.sec_id, dc.fnd_id FROM hr
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, sec_id, fnd_id, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm
AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm, hr_fn.rr
)
, rank_period AS (
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month mth, rp.*
, DENSE_RANK() over(PARTITION BY rp.fnd_id ORDER BY rp.PERIOD_GAP ASC, rp.PERIOD_TYPE DESC) ord_period
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND rp.PERIOD_GAP >=0
AND lower(rp.rn_r) LIKE '%báo cáo tài chính%'
--ORDER BY rp.submit_id
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month mth, rp.*
, CASE WHEN rp.PERIOD_TYPE = 3
AND rp.PERIOD_VALUE = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))
AND rp.YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))
THEN 1 ELSE 2
END ord_period
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND lower(rp.rn_r) NOT LIKE '%báo cáo tài chính%'
--ORDER BY rp.submit_id
)
SELECT :filter_month "Tháng",
f.ITEM_NAME || ' -- ' || f.SHORT_NAME  "Tên quỹ",
s.ITEM_NAME "CTQLQ",
ft.ITEM_NAME "Phân loại",
CAST(nav."Giá trị" AS number) "NAV (tỷ đồng)",
CAST(lnlk."Giá trị" AS number) "Lợi nhuận (tỷ đồng)",
--CAST(ccq."Giá trị" AS number) "Số lượng CCQ",
f.TOTAL_QTTY "Số lượng CCQ",
dlpp.total "Số lượng ĐLPP",
bm.SHORT_NAME "NHGS",
dd.total "Số lượng TV ban DD",
dh.total "Số lượng người điều hành"
FROM FMS_UAT.FUNDS f 
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.SECURITIES s ON f.SEC_ID = s.ID AND s.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.FUND_TYPE ft ON f.FTYPE_ID = ft.ID AND ft.RECORD_STATUS = 1 AND ft.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.ID, f.ITEM_NAME FUND_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(t.ITEM_NAME) LIKE N'%đại lý phân phối%' THEN a.ID END) total 
                   FROM FMS_UAT.FUNDS f
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.FUD_AG_AGT faa ON f.ID = faa.FUD_ID
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.AGENCIES a ON faa.AGEN_ID = a.ID AND a.DELETED = 0 AND a.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.AGENCY_TYPE t ON faa.AG_TY_ID = t.ID AND t.DELETED = 0 AND t.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                   WHERE 1=1
                   AND f.DELETED = 0 
GROUP BY f.ID, f.ITEM_NAME) dlpp ON dlpp.ID = f.ID
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.BANK_MONI bm ON f.BANK_ID = bm.ID AND bm.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.ID, f.ITEM_NAME, count(DISTINCT r.id) total FROM FMS_UAT.FUNDS f
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.REPRESENT r ON f.ID = r.FUND_ID AND r.RECORD_STATUS = 1 AND r.DELETED = 0
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.JOBS j ON r.JOB_ID = j.ID AND j.DELETED = 0 AND j.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.JOB_TYPE jt ON j.JOB_TYPE_ID = jt.ID AND jt.DELETED = 0 AND jt.RECORD_STATUS = 1 AND lower(jt.ITEM_NAME) = 'ban đại diện'
                   WHERE 1=1
                   AND f.DELETED = 0 
                   GROUP BY f.ID, f.ITEM_NAME) dd ON dd.ID = f.ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.ID, f.ITEM_NAME, count(DISTINCT tp.id) total 
                   FROM FMS_UAT.FUNDS f
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.FUND_TL_PRO ftp ON f.ID = ftp.FUND_ID 
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.TL_PROFILES tp ON ftp.TLPR_ID = tp.ID AND tp.RECORD_STATUS = 1 AND tp.DELETED = 0
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.JOB_TL_PRO jtp ON tp.ID = jtp.TLPRO_ID 
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.JOBS j ON jtp.JOB_ID = j.ID AND j.DELETED = 0 AND j.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                   LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.JOB_TYPE jt ON j.JOB_TYPE_ID = jt.ID AND jt.DELETED = 0 AND jt.RECORD_STATUS = 1 AND lower(jt.ITEM_NAME) = 'ban điều hành'
                   WHERE 1=1
                   AND f.DELETED = 0 
                   GROUP BY f.ID, f.ITEM_NAME) dh ON dh.ID = f.ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sec_id, fnd_id, "Giá trị" FROM rank_period 
                  WHERE 1=1
                  AND ord_period = 1
                  AND s_r LIKE '%BCTaiSan%'
                  AND "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2217') nav ON nav.FND_ID = f.ID 
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sec_id, fnd_id, "Giá trị" FROM rank_period 
--                  WHERE 1=1
--                  AND ord_period = 1
--                  AND s_r LIKE '%BCTaiSan%'
--                  AND "Mã chỉ tiêu" = '2218') ccq ON ccq.FND_ID = f.ID 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sec_id, fnd_id, "Giá trị" FROM rank_period 
                   WHERE 1=1
                   AND ord_period = 1
                   AND (s_r LIKE '%BCKetQuaHoạtDongKinhDoanh%' OR s_r = 'BCThuNhap_06203')
                   AND "Mã chỉ tiêu" IN ('41','50')) lnlk ON lnlk.FND_ID = f.ID 
WHERE 1=1
AND f.DELETED = 0  
AND TRUNC(LAST_DAY(f.ID_DATE)) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month, 'MM/YYYY'))

WITH cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", rt.ID rpid, rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME"
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS, rt.VERSION
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c,
posi.id,
name.v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL,
'$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY,
NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS
(r NUMBER PATH '$.row',
c NUMBER PATH '$.col',
id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%đại lý phân phối%'
AND s.ITEM_NAME = 'TinhHinhGiaoDichCCQ_06268'
)
,cf AS (
SELECT
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE
, CASE WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 6 THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 5 THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '1' THEN last_day(to_date('03/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '2' THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '3' THEN last_day(to_date('09/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
WHEN rm.PERIOD_TYPE = 4 AND rm.period_value = '4' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(rm.year_value),'mm/yyyy'))
ELSE NULL
END MONTH_VALUE
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.MEB_ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, rm.RECORD_STATUS rs
, rm.RECORD_TYPE
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON HEXTORAW(UPPER(REPLACE(cte.id,'-',''))) = rv.TGT_ID
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 8
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY cte.row_idx, cte.col_idx
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, sec_id, fnd_id, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY VERSION DESC) 
END ord
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS rr, report_name AS rn_r, sheet_name AS s_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1,2,3,4)
AND col_idx IN (1,2)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, report_name, sheet_name
)
, hc AS (
SELECT DISTINCT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, report_name AS rn_c, sheet_name AS s_c
, DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, period_type, period_value, year_value, month_value
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 4 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo trước"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Lũy kế"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ trước"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1,2,3,4)
AND col_idx IN (3,4,5)
AND ord = 1
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, report_name, sheet_name, DISTRIBUTOR_ID, period_type, period_value, year_value, month_value
)
, label AS (
SELECT cvt.convert_ft "filter_value",
CASE WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'tháng' THEN TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'MM/YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cvt.convert_ft) IN (1,2,3) THEN 'Quý 1/' || TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cvt.convert_ft) IN (4,5,6) THEN 'Quý 2/' || TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cvt.convert_ft) IN (7,8,9) THEN 'Quý 3/' || TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cvt.convert_ft) IN (10,11,12) THEN 'Quý 4/' || TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'năm' THEN TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
 END "filter_label"
FROM (
SELECT  
CASE WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter,1,2)) = 'q1' THEN last_day(to_date('03/' || SUBSTR(:filter,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter,1,2)) = 'q2' THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || SUBSTR(:filter,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter,1,2)) = 'q3' THEN last_day(to_date('09/' || SUBSTR(:filter,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter,1,2)) = 'q4' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || SUBSTR(:filter,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'năm' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(:filter),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'tháng' THEN last_day(to_date(:filter,'mm/yyyy'))
END convert_ft
FROM dual
) cvt
ORDER BY cvt.convert_ft
)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
label."filter_label"
, hr_fn.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, hr_fn.rr, hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm
, hc.rn_c, hc.s_c
, hc.PERIOD_TYPE, hc.PERIOD_VALUE, hc.YEAR_VALUE, hc.month_value
, hr_fn."STT"
, hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Kỳ báo cáo", hc."Kỳ báo cáo trước", hc."Lũy kế"
 , CASE WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND decode(hc.PERIOD_TYPE,4,'quý',5,'bán niên',6,'năm') = 'quý' AND hc.month_value = label."filter_value" THEN 1
                WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'năm' AND hc.year_value = :filter THEN DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hr_fn.DISTRIBUTOR_ID, hc.YEAR_VALUE ORDER BY hc.PERIOD_TYPE DESC, hc.PERIOD_VALUE ASC)
ELSE 2
END ord_period
FROM (SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.DISTRIBUTOR_ID FROM hr
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, DISTRIBUTOR_ID, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm
JOIN label ON 1=1
AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
WHERE 1=1
--ORDER BY hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm, hr_fn.rr
)
SELECT label."filter_label"
, nullif(tc.total,0) + nullif(cn.total,0) + nullif(nn.total,0) "Tổng"
, tc.total "Tổ chức trong nước"
, cn.total "Cá nhân trong nước"
, nn.total "Nước ngoài"
FROM  label
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "filter_label", SUM(CAST("Kỳ báo cáo" AS number)) total
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND "STT" = '4.1'
AND ord_period = 1
GROUP BY "filter_label") tc ON label."filter_label" = tc."filter_label" 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "filter_label", SUM(CAST("Kỳ báo cáo" AS number)) total
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND "STT" = '4.2'
AND ord_period = 1
GROUP BY "filter_label") cn ON label."filter_label" = cn."filter_label" 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT "filter_label", SUM(CAST("Kỳ báo cáo" AS number)) total
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
AND "STT" = '4.3'
AND ord_period = 1
GROUP BY "filter_label") nn ON label."filter_label" = nn."filter_label"

WITH label AS (
SELECT cvt.convert_ft "filter_value",
CASE WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'tháng' THEN TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'MM/YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cvt.convert_ft) IN (1,2,3) THEN 'Quý 1/' || TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cvt.convert_ft) IN (4,5,6) THEN 'Quý 2/' || TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cvt.convert_ft) IN (7,8,9) THEN 'Quý 3/' || TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cvt.convert_ft) IN (10,11,12) THEN 'Quý 4/' || TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
           WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'năm' THEN TO_CHAR(cvt.convert_ft,'YYYY')
 END "filter_label"
FROM (
SELECT  
CASE WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter,1,2)) = 'q1' THEN last_day(to_date('03/' || SUBSTR(:filter,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter,1,2)) = 'q2' THEN last_day(to_date('06/' || SUBSTR(:filter,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter,1,2)) = 'q3' THEN last_day(to_date('09/' || SUBSTR(:filter,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'quý' AND lower(SUBSTR(:filter,1,2)) = 'q4' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || SUBSTR(:filter,-4),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'năm' THEN last_day(to_date('12/' || to_char(:filter),'mm/yyyy'))
         WHEN lower(:filter_type) = 'tháng' THEN last_day(to_date(:filter,'mm/yyyy'))
END convert_ft
FROM dual
) cvt
ORDER BY cvt.convert_ft
)

WITH cte AS (
SELECT
LOWER(RAWTOHEX(s.ID)) "sid", s.ID "sraw", rt.ITEM_NAME "REPORT_NAME", rt.CODE, s.ITEM_NAME "SHEET_NAME", rt.LEGAL_BASIS, rt.VERSION 
, rt.DELETED, rt.RECORD_STATUS
, name.row_idx, name.col_idx
, posi.r, posi.c,
posi.id,
name.v
FROM FMS_UAT.RPT_TEMP rt
JOIN FMS_UAT.SHEET s ON s.RPT_ID = rt.ID AND s.RECORD_STATUS = 1
CROSS JOIN json_table (s.DATA_LABEL, 
                                                        '$[*]' COLUMNS (row_idx FOR ORDINALITY, 
                                NESTED PATH '$[*]' COLUMNS (col_idx FOR ORDINALITY, v VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$'))
) name
LEFT JOIN json_table (s.CELLS_META, '$[*]' COLUMNS 
                                                                        (r NUMBER PATH '$.row', 
                                                                        c NUMBER PATH '$.col', 
                                                                        id VARCHAR2(1000) PATH '$.uid')
) posi ON name.row_idx - 1 = posi.r AND name.col_idx - 1 = posi.c
WHERE rt.DELETED = 0 AND rt.RECORD_STATUS = 1
AND (lower(rt.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%danh mục đầu tư%')
--AND s.ITEM_NAME = '' ==>>> chưa có biểu mẫu excel nên tạm thời để trống
)
,cf AS (
SELECT 
cte.*
, COALESCE(rm.PERIOD_TYPE, rp.PERIOD_TYPE) PERIOD_TYPE, rm.PERIOD_VALUE, rm.YEAR_VALUE
--, CASE WHEN cte.v IS NOT NULL AND cte.v != ' ' THEN TO_NCHAR(cte.v) ELSE rv."VALUES" END vl
, rv."VALUES" AS vl
, rv.MEB_ID as SUBMIT
, rm.DATE_SUBMITTED
, rm.RPT_NAME
, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(rv.TGT_ID)) AS TGT_ID
, rm.BKM_ID
, rm.FND_ID
, rm.FR_BR_ID
, rm.SEC_ID
, rm.DISTRIBUTOR_ID
, rm.TRANSFER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_PROVIDER_ID
, rm.OTHER_AGENT_ID
, rm.PENSION_FUND_ID
, rm.AUDIT_FIRM_ID
FROM cte
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_VALUES rv ON HEXTORAW(UPPER(REPLACE(cte.id,'-',''))) = rv.TGT_ID
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_MEMBER rm ON rv.MEB_ID = rm.ID AND rm.DELETED = 0 AND rm.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,5,10) AND rm.RECORD_TYPE = 4
LEFT JOIN FMS_UAT.RPT_PERIOD rp ON rm.PRD_ID = rp.ID AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND rp.RECORD_STATUS = 1
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cte.row_idx, cte.col_idx
)
, ord_rp AS (
SELECT cf.*
, CASE WHEN tgt_id IS NULL THEN 1
           ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sheet_name, FR_BR_ID, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, YEAR_VALUE 
                                ORDER BY VERSION DESC) 
END ord 
FROM cf
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cf.row_idx, cf.col_idx, cf.YEAR_VALUE desc, cf.code, cf.PERIOD_TYPE, cf.PERIOD_VALUE
)
, hr AS (SELECT row_idx AS rr, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS rsm, sheet_name AS s_r, report_name AS rn_r
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 1 THEN v END) AS "STT"
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 2 THEN v END) AS "Chỉ tiêu"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN v END) AS "Mã chỉ tiêu"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND ord = 1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (1,2)
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, sheet_name, report_name
)
, hc AS (SELECT row_idx AS cr , LOWER(RAWTOHEX(SUBMIT)) AS csm, sheet_name AS s_c, report_name AS rn_c
                                , FR_BR_ID
                , period_type, period_value, year_value
, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 3 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 5 THEN vl END) AS "Kỳ báo cáo"
--, max(CASE WHEN col_idx = 12 THEN vl END) AS "Tổng"
FROM ord_rp
WHERE 1=1
AND ord = 1
AND row_idx NOT IN (1)
AND col_idx IN (3)
AND PERIOD_VALUE = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) AND YEAR_VALUE = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY')) 
AND PERIOD_TYPE = 3
--AND LOWER(RAWTOHEX(cf.SUBMIT)) = '60113e30450b46f3a63287269ed41006'
GROUP BY row_idx, SUBMIT, sheet_name, report_name, FR_BR_ID, period_type, period_value, year_value)
, rp AS (
SELECT DISTINCT :filter_month "Tháng"
, hr_fn.FR_BR_ID
, hr_fn.rr, hr_fn.rn_r, hr_fn.s_r, hr_fn.csm
, hc.rn_c, hc.s_c
, hc.PERIOD_TYPE, hc.PERIOD_VALUE, hc.YEAR_VALUE
, hr_fn."STT", hr_fn."Chỉ tiêu"
, hc."Kỳ báo cáo"
FROM (SELECT hr.*, dc.csm, dc.FR_BR_ID, dc.rn_c, dc.s_c FROM hr
                           LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT csm, FR_BR_ID, rn_c, s_c FROM hc) dc ON hr.rn_r = dc.rn_c AND hr.s_r = dc.s_c
         ) hr_fn
LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.cr = hr_fn.rr AND hc.csm = hr_fn.csm 
                         AND hc.s_c = hr_fn.s_r AND hc.rn_c = hr_fn.rn_r
WHERE 1=1
)
, dmdt AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
:filter_month "Tháng"
--, rp.FR_BR_ID
, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(rp."Chỉ tiêu") LIKE  '%số hợp đồng ủy thác đầu tư%' THEN CAST(rp."Kỳ báo cáo" AS number) END) slhd
, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(rp."Chỉ tiêu") LIKE  '%giá trị thị trường%' THEN CAST(rp."Kỳ báo cáo" AS number) END) gttt
FROM rp
WHERE 1=1
--AND rp.s_r = ''  ==>>> chưa có biểu mẫu excel nên tạm thời để trống
AND (lower(rp."Chỉ tiêu") LIKE  '%số hợp đồng ủy thác đầu tư%' OR lower(rp."Chỉ tiêu") LIKE  '%giá trị thị trường%')
GROUP BY :filter_month
)
SELECT total.*, dmdt.slhd "Số lượng HĐQLDM", dmdt.gttt "Giá trị HĐ"  FROM (
SELECT :filter_month "Tháng", COUNT(fb.ID) "Số lượng CNNN tại VN"
FROM FMS_UAT.FOR_BRCH fb 
WHERE 1=1
AND fb.DELETED = 0
AND fb.BRANCH_FLAG = 1
AND LAST_DAY(COALESCE(fb.START_DATE, fb.LICENSE_DATE)) <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(:filter_month,'MM/YYYY'))
GROUP BY :filter_month
) total
LEFT JOIN dmdt ON total."Tháng" = dmdt."Tháng"
